subject: Both short and long sleep tracked faster organ aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Both short and long sleep tracked faster organ aging. A new study using organ-specific 'aging clocks' finds that both too little and too much sleep are tied to faster aging across the body. Short and long sleep linked to faster organ aging. Optimal sleep range: 6.4 to 7.8 hours. Sleep duration tied to depression, heart disease, diabetes. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
